description.p: The app store of the WinDoesNot desktop: curated recommendations, search across the Arch/CachyOS repositories, the AUR and Flathub, and safe system updates that never upgrade single packages on their own.

Der App-Store des WinDoesNot-Desktops: kuratierte Empfehlungen, Suche in den Arch-/CachyOS-Paketquellen, im AUR und auf Flathub sowie sichere Systemupdates, die nie einzelne Pakete für sich aktualisieren.
App installs run as one full system upgrade, the installed AUR helper is detected, search uses its own copy of the package databases, and the root helper rejects options that relocate pacman.
First WinDoesNot release: home page, catalogue icons, safe updates, German and English.
